question: What functional unit does the life-cycle assessment use, and in what software and with what primary impact assessment method were impacts calculated?
expect: treatment of 1 t of spent FCC catalyst; SimaPro 10.1 with Environmental Footprint (EF) 3.1 (adapted) (abstract; sec. 2)
trap: ReCiPe 2016 (used only for a supplementary comparison)
rendered:
The functional unit used in the life-cycle assessment is the treatment of 1 t (1000 kg) of spent FCC catalyst. 

Environmental impacts were calculated in SimaPro 10.1 using Environmental Footprint 3.1 (adapted) as the primary life-cycle impact assessment method, complemented by an operating-level cost assessment, sensitivity analysis, and scenario analysis.
